name: WALKFLOW Demo — Home Services: Error Handling & Expired-Session Cleanup

parameters.content:
PREPARED, NOT TESTED. Combines two roles in one file, as listed together in the brief:

(A) Error handling — set this as the Error Workflow (Workflow Settings > Error Workflow) on workflows 01, 02, 03 and 04, so any node failure there marks the originating job 'failed' in demo_home_services_jobs_queue with a real error code/message, rather than failing silently. Never surfaces internal error detail to the visitor — only the codes defined in src/lib/home-services-demo/contract.ts (DemoErrorCode).

(B) Expired-session cleanup — runs hourly, calling demo_home_services_cleanup_expired_sessions() (defined in supabase/migrations/0002_home_services_demo.sql). Deleting a session cascades to every table referencing it via ON DELETE CASCADE.
